First, note the given date format is MM-DD-YYYY: 08-13-1335.  
Subtract 131 days:  

1335 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1335 not divisible by 4).  
From 08-13 back 13 days → 07-31 (31 days in July).  
Remaining days to subtract: 131 - 13 = 118 days.  

From 07-31:  
July has 31 days, so back 31 days → 06-30. Remaining: 118 - 31 = 87 days.  
June has 30 days, back 30 days → 05-31. Remaining: 87 - 30 = 57 days.  
May has 31 days, back 31 days → 04-30. Remaining: 57 - 31 = 26 days.  
April has 30 days, back 26 days → 04-04.  

So new date: 1335-04-04.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1335-04-04
